primitives.name: Append-Only Credit Ledger
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Message 1 — Slice A Money OS Implement clip-pricing.ts, clip-ledger.ts, rewrite clip-credits.ts so every reserve/charge/refund/grant/download writes an append-only ledger row in the same transaction.
primitives.assumptions: Each transaction is idempotent under (R, C, V); all operations occur within atomic commit.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure at transaction boundary leads to inconsistent balance; rollback required.

layer2.mapping: Ledger rows form a monoid under concatenation; each entry maps to a GSI probabilistic belief update.

primitives.name: Prompt Optimization Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Message 2 — Slice B Intelligence OS Add clip-quality.ts + clip-optimizer.ts.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'p_{raw}': 'raw prompt string', 'p_{opt}': 'optimized prompt vector', 'Q': 'quality score (0–1)', 'f': 'optimization function'}
primitives.assumptions: Optimization preserves semantic fidelity while enhancing generation likelihood.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Semantic collapse when f(p_{raw}) fails to maintain p_{raw} integrity.

layer2.mapping: Clip optimizer applies gradient-free search over prompt space to maximize Q(p_{opt}) subject to constraint set.

primitives.name: Scene Director Policy
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Message 3 — Slice C Control OS + router Add clip-director.ts chips + parser, clip-presets.ts (8 recipes), clip-router.ts.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'S': 'scene spec object', 'B': 'director beats list', 'P': 'preset recipe identifier', 'M': 'model ID (string)'}
primitives.assumptions: Director policies are deterministic mappings from scene context to action sequence.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Policy failure when S lacks sufficient structure for B derivation.

layer2.mapping: Director policy maps scene state to a sequence of actions; modeled as a finite-state transducer over S × B.
layer2.telemetry: Beat alignment accuracy, preset adherence rate
